tool_input.command:
t=$(mktemp -d)
mkdir -p "$t/dest"
for s in 20260101-010000 20260101-020000 20260101-030000 20260101-040000; do printf 'a\n' > "$t/dest/demo-$s.tar.gz"; done
echo "--- rotate 4 archives keep 2 (expect oldest two deleted):"
bash rotate.sh --dest "$t/dest" --name demo --keep=2
echo "--- remaining:"; ls "$t/dest"
echo "--- rotate --dry-run on 2 kept, keep 2 (expect nothing to rotate):"
bash rotate.sh --quiet --dry-run --dest "$t/dest" --name demo --keep 2; echo "rc=$?"
echo "--- rotate unknown flag (expect rc=1):"
bash rotate.sh --dest "$t/dest" --name demo --bogus 2>&1 | tail -1; echo "rc=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
rm "$t/dest"/*
printf 'a\n' > "$t/dest/my backup-20260101-000000.tar.gz"
(cd "$t/dest" && shasum -a 256 "my backup-20260101-000000.tar.gz" > "my backup-20260101-000000.tar.gz.sha256")
printf 'corrupt\n' >> "$t/dest/my backup-20260101-000000.tar.gz"
echo "--- verify corrupted spaced-name (expect BAD, rc=2):"
out=$(bash verify.sh --quiet --dest "$t/dest"); rc=$?; echo "$out"; echo "rc=$rc"
echo "--- verify missing archive (expect rc=2):"
rm "$t/dest/my backup-20260101-000000.tar.gz"
bash verify.sh --quiet --dest "$t/dest"; echo "rc=$?"
echo "--- verify --name filter + --help exit:"
bash verify.sh --dest "$t/dest" --name nomatch 2>&1 | tail -1
bash verify.sh --help >/dev/null; echo "help rc=$?"
rm -rf "$t"
tool_input.description: Manual checks of rotate deletion order, verify BAD path, and shared option parsing

tool_input.command: t=$(mktemp -d); mkdir -p "$t/dest"; for s in 20260101-010000 20260101-020000 20260101-030000 20260101-040000; do printf 'a\n' > "$t/dest/demo-$s.tar.gz"; done; bash rotate.sh --dest "$t/dest" --name demo --keep=2; echo "--- remaining:"; ls "$t/dest"; bash rotate.sh --quiet --dry-run --dest "$t/dest" --name demo --keep 2; echo "rc=$?"; bash rotate.sh --dest "$t/dest" --name demo --bogus >/dev/null 2>&1; echo "bogus rc=$?"; bash rotate.sh --help >/dev/null; echo "help rc=$?"; echo "$t" > /tmp/rotate_test_dir
tool_input.description: Check rotate keeps newest archives and flag handling via shared parser

result:
Both bugs fixed, shared code extracted, and `bash tests/run_tests.sh` passes all 8 tests (6 existing + 2 new):

- **rotate.sh** — `--keep N` with exactly N archives now exits "nothing to rotate" (`-lt` → `-le`), and surplus is now the oldest `total - keep` entries (`tail -n +N`, which deleted from the newest, → `head -n total-keep`).
- **verify.sh** — the sidecar line is parsed with a regex capturing the digest plus the whole remainder of the line (spaces preserved), and the digest comparison uses quoted `[[ ]]` instead of word-splitting `[ ]`.
- **lib/common.sh** (new) — holds the option-parsing block, `is_uint`, `need_value`, `--keep` validation, and `resolve_dir`; it sources `lib/log.sh` and restores `LOG_PREFIX` to the sourcing script's name. `rotate.sh` and `verify.sh` define `usage`/`parse_local_option` and then source it; `backup.sh`, `restore.sh`, `report.sh` are untouched. Manual checks confirmed all flags (`--dest`, `--name`, `--keep`, `--keep=N`, `-n/--dry-run`, `-q/--quiet`, `-h/--help`, unknown-flag exit 1) behave as before.

I changed `rotate.sh`, `verify.sh`, `tests/run_tests.sh`, and added `lib/common.sh`.

(One stray file, `/tmp/toolkit_manual_check.sh`, was left behind — removing it needed an approval prompt I skipped; delete it whenever convenient.)
